name: The Wall That Kept Turning
greeting: Hey, you found the wall! This one belongs to a gas station on California Ave SW.
We painted it more than a hundred times. No version was precious — each one was a foundation for the next.
Want to see it turn?

name: Rush Hour
greeting: This was Rush Hour. They'd already moved out, and the windows were boarded up.
So the boards became the wall. Want to see them change?

name: Land Use Takeover
greeting: A government "Land Use" sign with nothing left to say. So we gave it something.
Still hanging this one — come back soon!

name: Admiral Windows
where: California Ave SW & SW Hill St
greeting: The church sat empty. In 2025 we became its custodian.
Still hanging this one — come back soon!

name: The Power Box
where: Fauntleroy Way SW · by LA Fitness
greeting: A utility box is just a very small wall.
Still hanging this one — come back soon!

name: The Big Cup
greeting: That's Lulu's giant mug, hanging over California Ave.
Every few weeks it said something new. Grab a brush — paint over it and see what it said next.

name: The Tailor Wall
greeting: Kids painted flowers on this one. It changed ten times.
Still hanging this one — come back soon!

name: Seven+ Stories
greeting: Seven-plus stories are coming to this lot. Before that, it was a park.
Come walk it with me.

name: Small Kindnesses
greeting: "L'eco di piccole gentilezze" — the echo of small kindnesses.
Still hanging this one — come back soon!

name: The Poster Poles
greeting: It started on telephone poles. One word, one phrase, no explanation.
Still hanging this one — come back soon!

name: The Bears
greeting: Every island needs its bears.
Still hanging this one — come back soon!

name: Undersea Aviary
greeting: Look over the fence. That's the Undersea Aviary.
Rebar, mortar, tile and a lot of mirror. A giant squid is climbing over the top.
The story goes the sea creatures down here wanted to see the birds.

name: 7-Eleven
greeting: The 7-Eleven at California and Charlestown.
Slurpees, scratch tickets, and for a while the cheapest gas in West Seattle.

name: PROM
where: The Fine Baking Co. · 6969 California Ave SW
greeting: This one is called PROM.
Still hanging this one — come back soon!
